changes.comment: COT tool rows show what the runtime said about the call: the row title is the runtime's summary (with a verb for read/list/search/edit rows and the tool name for rows without an action), the row carries the documented built-in icon for its action (bash/read/write/search), raw JSON arguments are no longer written into a titled row, and the expanded result shows the invocation as a code segment before the output. A read or edit that succeeded expands to the files it touched as pills (a +N pill stands for those past the pill budget) and nothing else; a failed one keeps its diff and output after the pills. Result code segments now use the documented code field. The card's own words are now English: row verbs (Read/List/Search/Edit), the Completed/Failed status lines, the truncation marker, and the titles and result text of Channel-owned and teammate tools (Reply on Feishu, Spawn teammate, Send to, Close teammate).
